stories.title: US bitcoin funds take in money again after three days of outflows, as a short squeeze lifts bitcoin back over $80,000
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs had a net inflow of $74.6M on Wednesday 4 November, ending three straight sessions of outflows that added up to about $1.16B. Bitcoin had dropped to about $75,600 around the US election before climbing back above $80,000 as traders who had bet on further falls were forced to buy back. One day of inflows has not undone the earlier selling, and BlackRock's IBIT still lost money.
points: Net ETF flows: -$643.2M on 30 Oct, -$398.6M on 2 Nov, -$115.6M on 3 Nov, then +$74.6M on 4 Nov, per Farside Investors data cited by crypto.news.
On 4 Nov Fidelity's FBTC took in $236.7M while BlackRock's IBIT lost $201.2M, per crypto.news.
About $378M of bets on falling prices were liquidated in one hour, and almost $747M in total, per CoinGlass data cited by crypto.news.
Bitcoin traded around $80,320 and ether around $2,425 when crypto.news published at 07:19 UTC on 5 Nov.

stories.title: Binance says a fake job interview helped hackers in its record theft; billions are still in their wallets
stories.summary: Binance released its investigation into the 29 October theft: attackers approached an engineer with a fake job interview, and the attack itself ran for about four hours. Co-CEO Richard Teng says about $2.85 billion has been frozen or intercepted and customers will not bear the losses. Blockchain tracker Elliptic puts the total stolen at $6.43 billion, with about $3.21 billion still in addresses tied to the theft. The lesson for ordinary users: a convincing job offer or file can be the way in.
points: Elliptic puts the theft at $6.43B across 11 blockchains, with about 44% ($2.85B) frozen or seized and about $3.21B still in addresses tied to the theft.
18,270 BTC sits in 19 addresses, unmoved since 29 Oct, and about 4,600 ETH ($10.7M) was swapped into bitcoin through THORChain overnight, per Elliptic.
Binance says 98% of affected assets have been replaced and deposits now exceed withdrawals hour by hour, per The Daily Hodl.
Attackers took their first steps in June with a tampered software download, then approached a Binance engineer in September with a fake job interview, per Malay Mail.
A Polygon proposal to hard-fork the chain and return about 70.49M POL (about $6.5M) is on the agenda of a call at 14:30 UTC on 5 Nov, per crypto.news.

stories.title: After the midterm sweep, the crypto lobby regroups as Democrats sketch a bill with a bigger SEC role
stories.summary: Democrats won both chambers of Congress, and House Democrats are discussing their own crypto market-structure bill for the next Congress that would give the SEC more power and the CFTC less. There is no bill text yet. The industry-backed CLARITY Act dies on 3 January unless it moves in the lame-duck session, while the stablecoin law (GENIUS Act) still takes effect on 18 January.
points: CLARITY passed the House 294-134 in July 2025 and failed a Senate cloture vote 49-50, per Bitcoin Magazine.
Fairshake, the industry's main super PAC, spent $56M against Sherrod Brown in Ohio, and he won, per CoinDesk.
Brown could be sworn in as early as 15 Dec, per The Block.
The GENIUS Act takes effect on 18 Jan and SEC tokenization work continues, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Cboe and Citadel back a suit against the CFTC over stock perpetual futures
briefs.summary: A lawsuit filed 3 Nov in New York federal court argues the CFTC-cleared single-stock perpetual futures are security-based swaps that belong to the SEC, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Trump Media moves about 4,259 BTC
briefs.summary: About 4,259 BTC (about $344M) moved from Trump Media wallets to a Crypto.com-linked address on 5 Nov; it is not confirmed as a sale, and noteholders can demand repayment of about $1B on 30 Nov, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: French bank hit by a cyberattack that ended in crypto
briefs.summary: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed a cyberattack in which fraudulent transfers were converted into crypto; ZachXBT puts losses above $133M, and the bank says client assets were not affected, per The Block.

briefs.title: Stripe adds stablecoin payouts for US businesses
briefs.summary: Eligible US businesses (not New York) can now send USDC payouts to crypto wallets in more than 160 markets, for $0.50 plus 0.5% per payout, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Circle reports $865M in quarterly revenue and cuts 5% of staff
briefs.summary: Circle reported $865M in Q3 revenue and reserve income and disclosed a 5% workforce reduction, per The Block.

briefs.title: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after a heist
briefs.summary: Mercado Bitcoin halted deposits and withdrawals on 2 Nov after more than $46M left the platform, per blockchain security firms, and Tether froze about $4.5M, per The Record.
